heart opening is an antimeme

my working model:

1. the premise is potentially insulting: 'what do you mean my heart is closed? I'm nice and good!'

there's a sensible reply: 'yes yes ofc you are nice and good, we're talking about somatic feedback that can enrich your life and deepen your relationships by permitting more synchrony with other people which is fun cool & useful'.

but this objection is ~never raised explicitly, so it's ~never addressed.

2. People hear 'heart opening' and think it MUST be a conceptual thing, when it's somatically & experientially literal. Or they go the other direction and think you're talking woo nonsense about the blood pumping organ --taking it physically literally when that is dubious.

Which is a more general kind of communication difficulty: 'experientially somatically literal but not physically literal' is a very important class of salient things for which most people do not have a mental category.

This is presumably downstream of naive perspectival realism, reinforced by linguistic convention and status pressure. ie, when we have the option to appropriate the authority of physical actuality in day to day speech, we typically take it. This permits little opening to deviate from the normal-but-imprecise ways people relay their experiences: since nearly nobody talks precisely in this way, if you try, people get very confused. Rounding off to solipsism is very common.

3. There aren't many people who can or will tell you how to do it. and many of those who can are obnoxiously woo --> miss their audience.

4. Heart opening brings new streams of interpersonal information which leads to Noticing things others would strongly prefer that you not.

5. Other people Notice without necessarily noticing that they have noticed, leading to absurd amounts of transference. ie, many MANY people having a gaping chasm of unmet needs in this area so if you're waving around an open heart, they very often get very weird in a surprising variety of unpleasant intense ways.

Worse, if you understand why heart awareness triggers a lot of bizarre bad behavior, you don't even get the satisfaction of being mad about it. It's just sad: hurt people hurting people since the dawn of time.

6. Dharma-specific: awareness from the heart illuminates sankhara in the body that is otherwise undetectable and goes unnoticed. This is short-term annoying if your goal is to speedrun awakening, because it presents a bunch of work to do that is effortless to pretend you've already done.

To put a finer point on it: if you follow popular meditation instructions competently you can 'disappear' into 'centerless awareness' and reasonably conclude you're making progress on the path. but if, in that moment you've disappeared, you look from the heart, there's a whole lotta solidity left to dissolve in spacious equanimity & grace.

ie, I think this is the mechanism for head awakenings. And many famous big name 'realized' meditation teachers out there have a strong vested status interest in not noticing they're only awake above the neck.
